_comment: Claude Code CLI telemetry -> CloudFuze AI-Governance. Merge this 'env' block into the user's ~/.claude/settings.json, OR enforce org-wide at C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json (macOS: /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json, Linux: /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json). The CLI then reports each prompt to /api/v1/otel/v1/logs and it appears in the AI Usage tab under 'Claude Code'. Replace localhost with the server host for remote machines. Prompt CONTENT is not sent (only prompt_length) unless OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS is set.
